name: Registry — Guide for AI
description: A map for AI to understand the registry/ folder, its files, and how the scanner works.

overview.title: What is this folder?
overview.content: registry/ contains the core files for the Honeycomb Scanner and the system registry. It is the single source of truth about the state of all honeycombs and the scanning process.

items.honeycomb_scanner.py: Main scanner script. Scans all honeycombs, validates structure, runs Symbiosis Guard checks (task validation, Ahimsa filter, deadline monitoring, integrity check).
items.scanner.json: Configuration for the scanner. Defines scanning logic, validation rules, update triggers, and Git integration.
items.registry.json: Main registry. Contains the current state of all honeycombs: metadata, statistics, health status, and change tracking. Updated automatically by the scanner.
items.scan_state.json: State of the last scan. Contains timestamps, honeycomb hashes, statistics, and a summary of Symbiosis Guard results (including lists of expired tasks, noise files, etc.). Updated automatically by the scanner.
items.index.json: Manifest of the registry/ folder itself. Describes the folder structure and files.
items.GUIDE.json: This file. A map for AI to understand the registry system.
items.schema.json: JSON Schema for validating all honeycomb index.json files. Defines required fields, types, and structure for every index.json in the system.
items.models.py: Pydantic models for type-safe validation of honeycomb data. Used by the scanner for structured validation.

relationships.title: File relationships
flow: scan_state.json (previous state) → honeycomb_scanner.py (reads for change detection)
registry.json → source of truth for system state

how_to_use.title: How AI should use these files

steps: For full health check: python honeycombs/registry/honeycomb_scanner.py scan --full-check
Check scan_state.json for a quick summary of the results.
Check registry.json for detailed information about all honeycombs.
Edit scanner.json if you need to change scanning logic, validation rules, or exclude patterns.
Do NOT edit registry.json or scan_state.json manually — they are overwritten by the scanner.
Always fetch the current version via API or raw URL before making decisions.
Never assume local state — use: https://api.github.com/.../registry.json or scan_state.json
Check scan_state.json for a quick overview, registry.json for deep details.

principles.title: Principles for AI
rules: Always fetch current versions via API — never assume local state.
Never patch without API pre-check — violation = resonance break.
After patch, request updated file via API — confirm SHA and version before reporting success.
Do not edit registry.json or scan_state.json manually — they are auto-generated.
Run the scanner after significant changes to update the registry.

migration_note.title: Migration note (2026-07-08)
migration_note.content: The scanner now uses unified works/ folder instead of separate tasks/ and roadmaps/.
details: Paths in honeycomb_scanner.py have been updated to point to honeycombs/works/.
TaskValidator and DeadlineSentinel now look for files in works/.
registry/ core/ folder has been removed as it was unused.
